post.summary: PayU Hosted Checkout with Pre-Authorize Payment

allOf.description: This parameter must contain the merchant key that was provided by PayU while onboarding.

txnid.description: The transaction ID is a reference number for a specific order that is generated by the merchant. It is used to track the order and must be unique. PayU's system will not accept duplicate transaction IDs.

amount.description: This field should contain the payment amount for the transaction.

productinfo.description: This field should be a string containing a brief description of the product.

firstname.description: The first name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

phone.description: The phone number of the customer.

allOf.description: This field must contain value as 1 to pre-authorize payments.
The "surl" field is the success URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is successful. The merchant can handle the response at this URL after the customer is redirected there.
The "furl" field is the Failure URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is failed. The merchant can handle the response at this URL after the customer is redirected there.

hash.description: This parameter must contain the hash value to be calculated at merchant end.

allOf.description: This parameter must contain the hash value to be calculated at merchant end.

lastname.description: Last name of the customer (must only contains alphabets).

curl.description: The "curl" field is the Cancel URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is canceled by the customer. The merchant can handle the response at this URL after the customer is redirected there.
